title: Expand package manager adapter contract and Debian fixture
purpose: Promote the Alpha package-install workflow from contract/stub into a typed adapter contract with Debian/Ubuntu fixture semantics.
scope: Define package metadata, isolated install, smoke, checkpoint, host promotion, host verification, and rollback report types.
Define Debian/Ubuntu fixture schema without hard-coding apt into AgentCore.
Define source digest, repository identity, package version, and rollback binding rules.
Define fail-closed behavior when host package manager is unavailable.
deliverables: runtime_contracts package adapter model additions or design doc
implementation_steps: Define versioned contract types or a doc-equivalent schema for package adapter reports.
Add fixture examples for valid, metadata mismatch, untrusted source, isolated smoke failure, and host promotion denied.
Map each report to required audit events and policy decisions.
Record evidence with contract status and future implementation files.
acceptance_criteria: Package identity includes name, version, source URI, source digest, and repository identity.
The contract can represent failed isolated install without host mutation.
Rollback binding is mandatory for host promotion.
verification: Run `cargo test -p runtime_contracts` if code changes are made.
Run `cargo test -p agent_core package_install` after workflow integration.
failure_modes: AgentCore depends directly on apt command strings.
Host install can happen before isolated validation.
Source digest or rollback id is optional for host promotion.

blocked_until: Package adapter contract and fixtures are defined.
